title: SLA_EVALUATED payload
description: The verdict of a versioned SLA policy over one or more USAGE_MEASURED events for one trade, and the payout ratio the escrow program enforces. A final evaluation carries a compact settlement attestation that the Solana program verifies on-chain.

terms_hash.description: Must equal the terms_hash of every referenced USAGE_MEASURED event and the seed of the escrow.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical policy document. The escrow terms carry the same three fields; the program rejects a mismatch.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical_json(payload) of the USAGE_MEASURED event.

inputs.description: Every USAGE_MEASURED event this verdict was computed from, by content hash. Contiguous sequences; the evaluator refuses gaps.

measured_ratio.description: Time-weighted consolidated uptime over the period.

gpu_identity.description: Whether the delivered GPUs were the contracted model and count. A mismatch in any window is a policy decision: the reference policy treats it as FAIL for the whole period.

delivered.description: Sum of consolidated gpu_hours over the inputs.

delivery_ratio.description: min(1, delivered / contracted), 6 fractional digits, rounded down.

variance_rel_max.description: Largest gpu_hours_rel variance across the inputs.

variance_tolerance.description: Maximum tolerated variance from the policy. Above it the reading is not trusted and the dimension fails.

outcome.description: PASS: release in full. PARTIAL: settle payout_bps to the provider, remainder to the buyer. FAIL: refund in full.

payout_bps.description: Share of the locked amount owed to the provider, in basis points. 10000 on PASS, 0 on FAIL, strictly between on PARTIAL. Computed by the policy; enforced by the program.

payout_rule.description: Human-readable statement of the formula the policy applied, for auditors. Informational; the numbers above are authoritative.

final.description: True when this verdict closes the trade and may be submitted to the escrow. Interim verdicts (false) are informational and carry no attestation.

message_hex.description: 147-byte fixed-layout message, hex encoded, defined in docs/escrow-spec.md: domain tag 'HLCSETL1' (8) || trade_id (32) || terms_hash (32) || policy_hash (32) || payout_bps (2, big-endian) || outcome (1: 0 FAIL, 1 PARTIAL, 2 PASS) || evaluated_at unix seconds (8, big-endian) || sla_payload_hash (32, SHA-256 of canonical_json of this payload with settlement_attestation removed).

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the raw message bytes, by the key named in the trade terms.

settlement_attestation.description: Present when final is true. The Solana program verifies this signature, not the JSON envelope, because the fixed layout fits in a transaction and needs no JSON parsing on-chain.
